mapper.sql: p.price_id, p.tenant_id, p.material_id, m.material_code, m.material_name, p.customer_id, c.customer_code, c.customer_name, p.trade_type, p.unit_price, p.currency, p.tax_type, p.vat_included_at, p.foreign_unit_price, m.unit AS material_unit, m.material_spec, CASE WHEN p.end_dt IS NOT NULL AND p.end_dt < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'past' WHEN p.start_dt > CURRENT_DATE THEN 'future' ELSE 'current' END AS price_status, p.start_dt, p.end_dt, p.moq, p.use_at, p.created_by, p.created_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_item_partner_price p LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = p.material_id AND m.tenant_id = p.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id AND c.tenant_id = p.tenant_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.price_id = #{priceId}

SELECT material_id AS "materialId", material_code AS "materialCode", material_name AS "materialName" FROM tb_material_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND material_id = #{materialId} AND delete_status = 'N' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT customer_id AS "customerId", customer_code AS "customerCode", customer_name AS "customerName" FROM tb_customer_info WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND use_at = 'Y'

SELECT m.material_id AS "materialId", m.material_code AS "materialCode", m.material_name AS "materialName", m.material_spec AS "materialSpec", m.unit AS "materialUnit" FROM tb_material_info m WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.delete_status = 'N' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
AND (m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_spec ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_item_partner_price p WHERE p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.material_id = m.material_id AND p.customer_id IS NULL AND p.trade_type = '매입' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND (p.end_dt IS NULL OR p.end_dt >= CAST(#{effectiveOn} AS DATE)))
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_item_partner_price p WHERE p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.material_id = m.material_id AND p.customer_id IS NULL AND p.trade_type = '매출' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND (p.end_dt IS NULL OR p.end_dt >= CAST(#{effectiveOn} AS DATE)))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_item_partner_price p WHERE p.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND p.material_id = m.material_id AND p.customer_id IS NOT NULL AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND (p.end_dt IS NULL OR p.end_dt >= CAST(#{effectiveOn} AS DATE)))
ORDER BY m.material_code LIMIT 2001

SELECT c.customer_id AS "customerId", c.customer_code AS "customerCode", c.customer_name AS "customerName", c.business_no AS "businessNo", COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) AS "priceCount" FROM tb_customer_info c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS price_count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, material_id, trade_type FROM tb_item_partner_price WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND use_at = 'Y' AND (end_dt IS NULL OR end_dt >= CAST(#{effectiveOn} AS DATE)) ) d GROUP BY d.customer_id ) cnt ON cnt.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.use_at = 'Y'
AND (c.customer_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.business_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) > 0
AND COALESCE(cnt.price_count, 0) = 0
ORDER BY c.customer_code LIMIT 2001
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item_partner_price SET end_dt = CAST(#{endDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS DATE), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{predecessorId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_item_partner_price WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{priceId}
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_item_partner_price ( tenant_id, material_id, customer_id, trade_type, unit_price, currency, tax_type, vat_included_at, foreign_unit_price, start_dt, end_dt, moq, use_at, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{materialId}, #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tradeType}, #{unitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{taxType}, #{vatIncludedAt}, #{foreignUnitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), #{moq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{useAt}, #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) RETURNING price_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_item_partner_price SET material_id = #{materialId}, customer_id = #{customerId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, trade_type = #{tradeType}, unit_price = #{unitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, currency = #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, foreign_unit_price = #{foreignUnitPrice,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, start_dt = CAST(#{startDt} AS DATE), end_dt = CAST(#{endDt} AS DATE), moq = #{moq,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, use_at = #{useAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND price_id = #{priceId}
